## 本周报道 | This week’s report

**中文。** 本周报道重述一项关于汤恩儿童化石年代、发育比较与南部非洲早期人类多样性的研究。它属于旧标本研究，不是本周新出土的化石。原始论文为 npj Palaeoecosystems，而非 Nature 主刊。

**English.** This week’s coverage revisits a study of the Taung Child’s age, developmental comparisons and southern African hominin diversity. It concerns a legacy specimen, not a fossil newly excavated this week. The paper is in npj Palaeoecosystems, not the flagship Nature journal.

## 日期与既往工作 | Dates and earlier work

**中文。** 化石发现于 1924 年；论文发表于 2026-11-05，VUB 机构稿为 2026-11-09。本期依据 2026-11-11 的报道列入。

**English.** The fossil was found in 1924; the paper was published on 2026-11-05 and the VUB release on 2026-11-09. Inclusion here is based on coverage dated 2026-11-11.

## 解释边界 | Limits of interpretation

**中文。** 论文全文本次访问受限。精确年代的上下限、标本层位关系及分类推论仍需阅读全文复核；本期不把媒体标题中的年龄当作直接测定骨骼的精确年代，也不宣布发现新物种。

**English.** Full-paper access was restricted. Age bounds, the specimen’s stratigraphic relationship and taxonomic inferences require full-text checking. A headline age is not treated as an exact direct date on the fossil, and no new species is declared.
